summary: Revision 2 (PR #84, closed without merge) drafted the Forked Fate Line Meaning companion article cleanly within the Director-verified Cheiro evidence boundary, but cumulative Director review found a small set of residual statements exceeding that boundary. Revision 3 revised only those statements and directly equivalent wording, preserving revision 2's sound structure and the verified Venus/Moon interpretation. Added src/content/blog/beginner/forked-fate-line-meaning.md (item 18 from docs/editorial-backlog.md's Next 25 list, 69 -> 70 published blog posts). Fixes: (1) removed the claim that Cheiro 'did not treat the configuration as a guarantee' -- unsupported by the evidence note -- and instead stated Cheiro's attributed historical reading and Palmistry Path's own non-deterministic editorial policy as two separate, explicitly labeled statements, in both the Venus/Moon section and the corresponding common-mistakes entry; (2) removed or reworded population/content-prevalence framing (search results offering confident answers, content commonly skipping evidence limits, a claim 'repeated elsewhere'); (3) removed the FAQ's universal interpretive rule ('it depends entirely on where the fork occurs...') and the 'aren't read the same way' framing, replacing both with direct statements of what this site's evidence does and doesn't cover; (4) reviewed the Jupiter/Apollo/Mercury/Saturn mount-associations paragraph and made explicit that those associations are mentioned only to explain the declined synthesis, not as fork-specific evidence. Added the same single reciprocal-link sentence to fate-line.md as revision 2. Updated docs/editorial-backlog.md (published count + row 18), docs/CHANGELOG.md, and docs/source-verification-log.md (Pass 14, full claim-by-claim disposition against the revision-2 residual-claim list).
